newsitem.title: UK: SMITHS INDUSTRIES RAISES JAPAN UNIT STAKE.
newsitem.headline: SMITHS INDUSTRIES RAISES JAPAN UNIT STAKE.

text.p: Britain's Smiths Industries Plc said on Wednesday it would add about 23 million stg of debt to its balance sheet as a result of its majority stake in its Japanese medial systems distributor.
Over the past year, Smiths raised its interest in Japan Medico to 62 percent from 50 percent, bringing the company's total investment to 8.0 million stg.
"Due to the very low interest rates in Japan, the business has largely been funded by local borrowings which, on consolidation, will be about 23 million stg," the company said in a statement.
Japan Medico had pretax profits of 9.0 million stg on sales of 65 million stg in the year to March 31.
